---
title: "Seasons"
---

```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(ggridges)
```

```{r}
mallards <- read_rds("data/mallards.rds")
```

```{r}
mallards |>
  count(month_num, month)
```

```{r}
summary(mallards$speed)
```

```{r}
mallards |>
  filter(speed <= 30) |>
  mutate(month = fct_reorder(month, month_num)) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = speed, y = month)) +
  ggridges::geom_density_ridges() +
  labs(
    title = "Mallard speed distributions by month",
    x = "Speed (m/s)",
    y = "Month"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```
